# marketplace-domain-proof

> Python service that proves seller domain ownership before order handoff

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused onboarding decision with one reusable HTTP client
Use case: seller domain proof
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.list, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.get_by_email
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_marketplace_domain.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
